answer.reason: Only Jeremiah's oracle says anything happened to Arpad, while the Assyrian boasts name it only in rhetorical questions and comparisons.

clauses.english: was confounded and fainthearted at hearing evil tidings
clauses.quote: Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings

doubts: The Assyrian speeches (2KI 18:34, 2KI 19:13, ISA 36:19, ISA 37:13) and ISA 10:9 only name Arpad in questions and comparisons, so they were not used as events.
